scope.summary: Implement booklet/imposition arranging pages for folding: N-up and booklet imposition (2-up saddle-stitch, 2-up perfect-bound, and consecutive) with creep, bleed-between-pages, and signature controls, producing an imposed StudioExportRecipe output through the quiet/headless path (MT-181).
acceptance_criteria: N-up + booklet imposition (saddle-stitch/perfect-bound/consecutive) with creep/bleed/signature as imposed recipe
proof_targets: saddle-stitch imposition runtime; N-up/perfect-bound + creep test
expected_tests: live: 2-up saddle-stitch imposition reorders pages for folding with creep + bleed-between-pages
test: N-up + perfect-bound + consecutive modes with signature controls produce imposed recipe output

risk_if_missed: No fold-ready output; booklets/signatures cannot be produced for print.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
PostgreSQL/SQLite creep or a write that bypasses the typed SurrealDB boundary on a studio_* authority path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
no_legacy_database_tripwire plus typed-SurrealDB-boundary proof on every authority write.
